{{Top}} {{Update|[[The High Republic — The Blade 2]], [[Endangered, Part 1]], [[Endangered, Part 2]], {{TBB|Spoils of War}}, {{TBB|Ruins of War}}}} {{StarshipClass |image=[[File:ImperialCargoShip-SWRebelsRetro.png]] |name=Class four container transport |designer= |manufacturer=[[Kuat Drive Yards]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' |line= |model= |type=[[Bulk freighter]]{{Rebels|The Forgotten Droid}} |cost= |modifier= |sysmods= |length=233 [[meter]]s |width= |height= |mass= |max accel= |mglt= |max speed=700 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] |maneuverability= |engine=[[Sublight engine]]s (3) |hyperdrive=Class 1 |hdrange= |hdsystem=Equipped |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=*Top-mounted double-barreled [[turbolaser]] battery (1) *Side-mounted [[laser turret]]s (2) |complement= |bays= |escapepods=6{{TBB|Spoils of War}} |crew=*2 [[pilot]]s *4 [[gunner]]s *1 [[captain]] *1 [[cargo master]] *1 [[navigator]] |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity=230 large containers''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems=Container-mounted sublight engines |availability= |role=Hauling cargo crates and containers{{Databank|imperial-cargo-ship|Imperial Cargo Ship}} |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Navy]] *[[Phoenix Cell]] {{C|stolen}} }} '''Class four container transports''', also called a '''class four freighter''', '''Imperial Class 4 Cargo Ship''' or more simply as an '''Imperial cargo ship''', were tetrahedral, [[hyperspace]]-capable, [[bulk freighter]]s built by [[Kuat Drive Yards]] and used by the [[Galactic Empire]] to haul large numbers of crates and containers across [[the galaxy]]. ==Characteristics and role== {{Quote|This is a class four freighter, isn't it?''"
"''Yes, why?''"
"''Containers on class four freighters are equipped with reentry thrusters. We can escape in a cargo container.''"
"''You are correct. I am impressed.|Omega and [[Tech]]|{{TBB|Spoils of War}}}} [[File:Cargo_ship_bridge.png|thumb|left|200px|The bridge module of an Imperial cargo ship]] The class four container transport was shaped like a tetrahedron resting on the longest of its six edges. The [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] module was located in front of the ship, at the narrowest vertex of the recumbent tetrahedron, and resembled that of the [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]].{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} A typical standard yield for a class four transport was 230 large containers, which were attached to the rear triangular side of the ship, encased between the [[sublight engine]]s positioned at each of the three angles. However, containers could be removed to make room for a hangar bay at the rear of the cargo portion.{{Rebels|The Wynkahthu Job}} The cargo of the transport could be accessed from the inside through at least one entry and exit point between the cargo and the vessel. In addition to its sublight drives, the Imperial class 4 cargo ship{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Type of Ship in Rebels|video=iasSt3JSV4Q|nolive=1}} was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], which allowed it to travel through [[hyperspace]]. It was also armed, boasting one top-mounted double-barreled [[turbolaser]] battery and two side-mounted [[laser turret]]s. As a Class four freighter, Imperial cargo ships were required to have sublight re-entry thrusters equipped in all of their cargo containers in case of an emergency jettison; these engines were meant for last-ditch efforts and could only be fired when inside a [[planet]]ary [[atmosphere]]. Additional safety measures included six [[escape pod]]s stored in a section on the sides of the ship's bow which could be remotely jettisoned in case of an enemy boarding action to trap the intruders on board the ship. [[File:Class_four_pilot_station.png|thumb|290x290px|The Class four transport was piloted by two pilots seated in a tandem cockpit station]] Every Imperial cargo ship required the presence of an [[inventory droid]]. Such [[droid]]s were responsible for arranging the cargo and monitoring all the goods to ensure it was organized and safely arrived at its destination on time. Also, inventory droids were tasked with logging every item and crew member of the transport and in addition were able to view the Imperial data network. Imperial cargo ships were used to haul large quantities of containers and crates from [[spaceport]] to spaceport. For security purposes, Imperial cargo ships had [[stormtrooper]]s and a security complement of at least five [[DT-series sentry droid]]s. ==History== ===Early Empire=== Class four container transports were in use shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. On a [[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|mission]] to [[Corellia]], the rogue [[Cloning|clones]] of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] got past the [[planet]]'s [[sensor]]s undetected by attaching their [[shuttle]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], to the underside of the freight assembly of a transport approaching the planet, detaching when the ship was close enough to the planetary surface.{{TBB|Decommissioned}} [[File:Imperial_operation_serenno.png|thumb|left|290px|Three Class four transports were utilized by the Galactic Empire to extract Dooku's war chest from his Castle on Serenno]] Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|201}} the Bad Batch again encountered Imperial cargo ships, this time in [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[Castle Serenno|former palace]] on [[Serenno]] when they were tasked by [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]] to steal part of the Count's [[Dooku's war chest|war chest]] before it was taken over by the Empire. Three Class four transports, including [[Transport Three]], were involved in a massive transport operation based on the palace and guarded by [[Clone Captain]] [[Wilco]] and a force of [[clone stormtrooper]]s. [[Wrecker]], [[Tech]], [[Echo]], and [[Omega]] successfully infiltrated Transport Three while [[Hunter]] was providing cover, but the first team was trapped inside the ship when Captain Wilco ordered it to take off and detach its pods after noticing Hunter. Echo decided to jettison a cargo container in a desperate effort to use it as an escape vessel thanks to its emergency re-entry thrusters, but due to the container's thrusters malfunctioning the team was left trapped while it was freefalling to the planet, although the thrusters eventually fired and allowed them to survive the fall.{{TBB|Ruins of War}} During or after 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],{{TBBDate|312}} multiple class four transports traveled from the planet [[Erebus]].{{TBB|Juggernaut (episode)}} At one point, when the Empire [[Liberation of Chorin|liberated]] the planet of [[Chorin]], several class four container transports arrived with the Imperial fleet.[[Target Vader 2|''Target Vader'' 2]] ===War with the Rebellion=== {{Quote|You stole an Imperial freighter?|Hera Syndulla, to Chopper|}} [[File:Jettisoned_cargo.png|thumb|240x240px|In order to steal a cargo ship, Chopper jettisoned its freight assembly.]] In [[3 BBY]],''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack on Phoenix Squadron]] to three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], or [[3 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''{{'}} [[Galactic standard calendar|dating system]]. As the heist at [[Horizon Base]] take place immediately before the attack on [[Phoenix Squadron]], it can be determined that it also takes place in 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. the rebel [[Astromech droid|astromech]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] stowed away on an [[Imperial Cargo Transport 241|Imperial cargo ship]] docked at the [[Horizon Base]]. Eventually, the astromech joined forces with the ship's inventory [[droid]], an [[RA-7 protocol droid]] called [[AP-5]], to steal the vessel from the Empire. In order to do so, Chopper managed to trap the stormtroopers serving aboard the ship in the freight assembly, before jettisoning the soldiers along with the containers. AP-5 then transmitted the coordinates for the planet [[Atollon]] to Chopper's [[Spectres]] and the [[Phoenix Cell]] despite the opposition of the [[Unidentified Imperial cargo ship captain|Imperial captain]]. Chopper then rendezvoused the cargo transport with the rebels above Atollon. In [[2 BBY]], the [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and the [[Jablogian]] [[crime lord]] [[Azmorigan]] acquired the flight plan for a cargo transport. They disabled the transport with [[ion mine]]s. However, the ship drifted into the upper atmosphere of the planet [[Wynkahthu]], where it was trapped in a storm. Most of Hondo's [[Ugnaught]] crew with the exception of [[Melch]] were lost while boarding the ship. Hondo and Azmorigan managed to reach the ship with the help of the Spectres and AP-5, who was familiar with that class of ships. They managed to restart the ship and steal a cargo of [[proton bomb]]s and treasures. However, the recovery team was forced to flee when it accidentally activated the sentry droids. The recovery team fled back to their [[starship]], the ''[[Ghost]]'', before the cargo ship descended into the vortex and exploded. Later, during the Spectres' attempts to [[Liberation of Lothal|liberate]] the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] from the Empire, [[Hera Syndulla]], at Ohnaka's suggestion, latched the ''Ghost'' onto the hull of a container transport to sneak past the Imperial blockade of Lothal. After waiting for some time, they latched onto the ship once it exited [[hyperspace]], successfully passing through the Imperial blockade.{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} ==Behind the scenes== The Imperial cargo ship appears in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' series, first appearing in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second-season]] episode "[[The Forgotten Droid]]." [[Dave Filoni]], supervising director of the show's first two seasons, built a model of the cargo ship out of a manila folder when the show's crew was breaking the story of "The Forgotten Droid."{{Twitter|stevenmelching|status/711713613916950529|[[Steven Melching]]|date=2016-03-26|quote=Fun fact: Filoni built a model of this ship out of a manila folder while we were breaking the story.
